propositions: Jira work retry ownership is multiplied across nested loops and batch orchestration with no stable per-ticket versus batch scope or terminal failure classification.
A provider-neutral coordinator must enforce a three-call per-logical-postcondition and 15-second cumulative sleep budget with deterministic retry sequencing and Retry-After deference.

An endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least two tickets per endpoint family, distinct from the existing per-pass blast-radius guard.
Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id), optional property enrichment second, and safety-abort with known-key if local persistence fails.

Live external integration must validate the coordinator end-to-end against both ephemeral Jira DC (full multi-issue reconcile) and shared Jira Cloud (bounded uniquely-labeled throwaway issues with automatic cleanup).
